title: Frontiers: Does Carrying News Increase Engagement with Non-News Content on Social Media Platforms?
eligible_reason: Single-date design. Facebook's February 2021 news block in Australia, with New Zealand accounts as controls: feols(log_engage ~ au*after + age + age_square | post_id + day, cluster = account_id) for engagement (time-varying post-age controls) and feols(log_posts ~ after*au | account_id + day) for content generation, plus leads/lags event studies (au_after_-6..6) around the same date and heterogeneity triple interactions. One treated country and one adoption date, so not staggered.
design_notes: R (fixest). Replication_Files/user_engagement.R (Tables 2-5, Figure 4 engagement) and content_generation.R (Table 6, Figure 4 content).
data_provenance_note: README: synthetic data built from a random subset of Facebook posts and accounts with noise added.
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text). One treated country, one date; synthetic data.
